lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Birdie!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Are you available?
I'm busy.
Sorry, I'm not available at the moment.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Perfect, I knew you'd have time for me.
That's not what I said...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Do you remember that rescue operation we did together?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: The one with the fire.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: If you recall, one of the people we rescued was a little girl.
I remember.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: that little girl sent a package to Matis.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: However!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A hero should never expect a reward for saving the weak and defenseless.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: It is simply something we do because it is right.
So what'd you do with the package?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: On the other hand, rejecting a gift someone has given out of gratitude

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: is far from heroic as well.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: So, I'm about to open the package.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: However, since you were also a part of this operation,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I wanted to contact you first so that we can share this special moment together.
That's very nice of you.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: All right then, I'm gonna open it!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I wonder what's inside...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A massive amount of credits that I'd have no use for?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Or perhaps a gargantuan bar of Splendamin that I wouldn't be able to finish in a lifetime?
Well, what's inside?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: It's a letter that reads:

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Thank you for saving me.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Despite us losing all of our possessions in the fire,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I now have a new dream,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: which is to be just like Laplace.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I want to become a cool hero who saves others too.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Be careful out there fighting the bad guys.
That's the best gift anyone could ask for.
... Are you crying?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A human should hardly be concerned for a hero's safety...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A hero never cries!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: But since she took the time to write this letter,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I should keep it safe.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Do you have any spare picture frames lying around?
I might.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: If you do, let me borrow one,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: and I'll put this on the nightstand beside my bed.
Hehe, okay.
